p: SIXXAB AI ("SIXXAB", "we") provides an AI agent platform that helps companies plan, market, sell and operate. Questions about this policy: sunil.kattikar@gmail.com.
Account details you give us to sign in: your email address or mobile number.
Business information you or your team enter, and the work our agents create for you, including drafts, approvals and an activity log.
Basic technical data needed to run the service securely, such as device and browser type and error logs.
To provide the service you signed up for: running your agents, holding actions for your approval, and sending your morning briefing.
To keep the service secure and improve how your own agents perform for your company. We do not sell your personal information.

We use trusted providers to run SIXXAB, including Supabase (database and sign-in), Vercel (hosting), Anthropic (AI models) and messaging providers for SMS and email. They process data only to provide their service to us.
You can ask us to access, correct, export or delete your data at any time by emailing us. You can stop using the service and close your account whenever you like.

Data is encrypted in transit, separated by company, and access is limited to people who need it. We keep data while your account is active and delete it after closure unless the law requires us to keep it longer.
We will post any changes on this page and update the effective date.
SIXXAB AI provides AI agents that draft, recommend and, where you allow it, carry out business tasks. You decide which actions need your approval, and you can change those settings at any time.
You are responsible for activity under your account and for keeping access to your email or mobile number secure.

You own your business data and the work the agents produce for you. AI output can be wrong; review it before relying on it, especially for anything legal, financial or medical. You are responsible for actions you approve or allow agents to take.
Do not use SIXXAB to break the law, send spam, mislead people, or harm others or the service.
Paid plans are 12-month contracts billed as stated in your order. Prices on our website are starting prices; your order sets your final terms.
The service is provided as is, to the extent the law allows. Our total liability is limited to the fees you paid in the 12 months before the claim.
